mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (doctor_id, schedule_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, booked_count, extra_slots, status, template_id) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{period}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalSlots}, #{bookedCount}, #{extraSlots}, #{status}, #{templateId})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, period = #{period}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, total_slots = #{totalSlots}, booked_count = #{bookedCount}, extra_slots = #{extraSlots}, status = #{status}, template_id = #{templateId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, booked_count, extra_slots, status, template_id, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, booked_count, extra_slots, status, template_id, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}

SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_slots, booked_count, extra_slots, status, template_id, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule WHERE schedule_date >= #{startDate} AND schedule_date <= #{endDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET booked_count = booked_count - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
